lessons.title: Practice Node and Singly Linked List
lessons.description: Implement ListNode and LinkedList.append / to_list. The test checks that LinkedList().to_list() equals [1, 2].
learning_objectives: Depot potters recount crates before dawn, and build a singly linked list append.

tests.name: test_append
tests.unittest_code:
def test_append(self):
    ll = LinkedList()
    ll.append(1); ll.append(2)
    self.assertEqual(ll.to_list(), [1, 2])

lessons.title: Practice Prepend and Length
lessons.description: Add prepend and __len__ to LinkedList. The test checks that len(ll) equals 2; LinkedList().head.value equals 1.
learning_objectives: Ridge potters recount crates before dawn, and insert at head in O.

tests.name: test_prepend
tests.unittest_code:
def test_prepend(self):
    ll = LinkedList()
    ll.prepend(2); ll.prepend(1)
    self.assertEqual(len(ll), 2)
    self.assertEqual(ll.head.value, 1)

lessons.title: Practice Unit 3 Checkpoint Linked Lists
lessons.description: Finish has_cycle. Detect whether a linked list has a cycle (Floyd). The test checks that has_cycle(a) is true; has_cycle(ListNode(1, ListNode(2))) is false.
learning_objectives: Marsh potters recount crates before dawn, and detect cycles with slow fast pointers.

tests.name: test_cycle
tests.unittest_code:
def test_cycle(self):
    a = ListNode(1); b = ListNode(2); c = ListNode(3)
    a.next = b; b.next = c; c.next = b
    self.assertTrue(has_cycle(a))
    self.assertFalse(has_cycle(ListNode(1, ListNode(2))))

source.name: Python official documentation (docs.python.org) — The while statement — Floyd two-pointer cycle detection loop (Language Reference)
